import urllib.request

pattern = "PA14".lower()
url = "https://rest.kegg.jp/list/organism"
request = urllib.request.Request(
    url,
    headers={"User-Agent": "Galaxy-KEGG-organism-query/1.0", "Accept": "text/plain"},
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
    text = response.read().decode("utf-8")

matches = []
for line in text.splitlines():
    if pattern in line.lower():
        matches.append(line)

if not matches:
    raise RuntimeError(f"No KEGG organism registry rows matched {pattern!r}")

with open("kegg_organism_matches.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("organism_registry_row\n")
    for line in matches:
        handle.write(line + "\n")

print(f"matched {len(matches)} KEGG organism rows for {pattern!r}")
